title: Who Can You Trust? — Unreliable Narrators
skills: evaluate a narrator's credibility and bias
compare a narrator's account with textual evidence
analyze how unreliable narration affects meaning and reader interpretation
alignment_note: Explores unreliable narrators and the ways bias, limited knowledge, distortion, and perspective can affect a reader's understanding of a story. Supports close reading, credibility evaluation, inference, point-of-view analysis, and evidence-based interpretation across high school English courses.
